title: Sindh Transfusion Of Safe Blood Amendment Ordinance 2005

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Transfusion Of Safe Blood Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
Sindh Transfusion
Of Safe Blood (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood, Act, 1996
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th September, 2005]
No. S.Legis.1(9)/2005, dated 6-9-2005.--The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Transfusion Of Safe Blood Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No. I of 1997

ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
Sindh Transfusion
Of Safe Blood (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood, Act, 1996
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th September, 2005]
No. S.Legis.1(9)/2005, dated 6-9-2005.--The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 5 of
Sindh Act No. I of 1997.--In the
Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood Act, 1996, hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, in section 5, in subsection (1), for clause (i), the following shall be
substituted:
"(i) Secretary to Government
of Sindh,
Health Department .Chairman;".

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Transfusion Of Safe Blood Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Act No. I of 1997

ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
ORDINANCE IX OF 2005
Sindh Transfusion
Of Safe Blood (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood, Act, 1996
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th September, 2005]
No. S.Legis.1(9)/2005, dated 6-9-2005.--The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 6 of
Sindh Act No. I of 1997.--In the
said Act, in section 6, after clause (f), the following new clause shall be
inserted:
"(ff) to seal any premises
being used illegally for transfusion of blood or its products or any blood bank
which is not working in accordance with the provisions of this Act;".
